rationale: Canonical CNB register hub; durable standalone entry point to the full CZ regulated banking/payments population.
Live JERRS licensing register: new entries and status changes are direct, diffable org-change signals.
Documented WS JERRS XML API — highest-value machine-readable monitoring target for entity/role/status diffs.
Official CSV/JSON open datasets of banks, PIs and intermediaries; low-friction structured baseline with ICO keys.
Standalone page defining the fit-and-proper approval route for bank board members; procedural anchor for A5 leadership signals.
Payments twin of the banking licensing page (PI/EMI/PISP-AISP suitability); payments weighted equally with banking.
Index page over c_005/c_006 on the same domain; useful pointer but adds nothing standalone to monitor.
Continuously updated enforcement-decision archive; licence withdrawals and suitability refusals are hard negative org-change evidence.
Recurring annual supervision report series (not a one-off) giving calibration counts on licensing and population change.
CNB press-release feed announcing Bank Board appointments and supervisory reorganisations; bilingual and durable.
Bank Board composition page; diffing it detects regulator leadership turnover and supports term-expiry forecasting.
Regulator job board — pure A5 hiring signal showing where CNB is building supervision/payments/IT capacity.
Authoritative commercial register of statutory-body members with dated start/end plus Sbirka listin; the confirmation layer for every leadership change.
ARES REST API is the practical ICO-keyed join between CNB register identifiers and officer/company data.
EBA PSD2 register with daily bulk download; independent cross-check of CZ PI/EMI entries and inbound passporting.
CZ is outside the SSM so ECB does not approve CZ boards; value limited to vocabulary and SSM-parent context.
Second statutory supervisor of banks/PIs; compliance contact-person duty and annual reports yield role and org signals.
Sub-page of the MF portal, weak direct leadership value and URL verification failed — recheck liveness before deciding.
Sub-index under the CNB seznamy hub already covered by c_001; mine it to extend the actor map, not a separate monitor.
Court collection surfacing contested fit-and-proper cases, but legal_status unclear and volume very low — clarify reuse terms first.
KB newsroom names board appointments and division-director changes with effective dates; year-partitioned archive.
KB issuer disclosure stream: cleanest structured predecessor/successor board-change record in CZ banking.
Ceska sporitelna press archive with date-pathed URLs; board, director and Erste-group talent-flow announcements.
Management roster page whose diffs catch silent departures and portfolio reallocations that never get a press release.
CSOB newsroom covers board composition changes and senior hires across the whole KBC-owned CZ group.
Group insurer newsroom; catches bank-to-insurer executive rotations that surface here first.
Listed bank press centre with AGM/board announcements and mechanical year-partitioned crawl surface.
Raiffeisenbank CZ newsroom publishes board changes on a clean year/month URL scheme.
PPF-group digital bank press page plus annual reports naming statutory bodies; ongoing org-change feed.
Fio banka press stream plus in-house market news desk that also relays other banks' board announcements.
